messages:
Jordan (CS): FYI — AcmeHealth dedicated cluster (eu-west-1) reporting recurring ECC/Xid errors on GPU 7 of host rwd-ded-eu-04. We've already moved workloads off that card and routed traffic to spare capacity. Drafting a customer note below, PTAL.

Jordan (CS): Draft for customer:
---
Hi AcmeHealth team,

We're contacting you about a hardware instability we've detected on one of the GPUs in your dedicated cluster in eu-west-1 (host rwd-ded-eu-04, GPU 7). We've observed intermittent ECC/Xid errors that have caused a small number of degraded or retried inference requests. To prevent impact we executed an automated failover of active workloads to spare capacity and drained the affected GPU.

Planned action: replace the GPU card during your maintenance window. Proposed window: Mon 2026-03-23 23:00–23:30 UTC.

Customer impact: we expect no sustained downtime. Active streaming sessions may see short reconnects (typically <5s) during the host-level swap. No user data or model state will be changed. We will monitor the cluster closely for 24h after replacement and provide a verification summary and logs.

If you prefer an immediate replacement outside the proposed window, reply and we will prioritize with ops.

Regards,
Jordan — Customer Success
---

Maya (Runbooks): +1 to send. Suggest adding a single sentence explicitly: "No user data was lost" and include the runbook ref RWB-8472 in the note.

Priya (Ops): Ops notes: to be explicit — replacement requires a host-level GPU hot-swap and a short host reboot is possible depending on vendor kit. On-site vendor ETA if escalated: ~36-48h. We can do a hot-swap in-rack with no full host replacement if spare card is available; otherwise vendor will swap the board.

Liam (AM): AcmeHealth told me they prefer after-hours windows. Can we tighten to Mon 2026-03-23 22:00–23:30 UTC? They want minimal user-visible impact.

Jordan (CS): I proposed Mon 2026-03-23 23:00–23:30 UTC as compromise and added: "We will monitor 24h post-replace and reopen immediately if regressions appear."

Priya (Ops): Confirmed from ops — hot-swap during that slot is doable with standard rollback plan. Add this sentence to the customer note: "We will keep your cluster pinned to the current model/version; inference state and model files are untouched during hardware replacement."

deploy-bot: Pre-checks executed: no active canary or long-running debug sessions on rwd-ded-eu-04. CI/infra check rwd/infra#901 passed.

Jordan (CS): Updated draft with runbook ref and the "no data lost" sentence, sent to AcmeHealth for ack. Will post final notice here after ack. :white_check_mark:
